item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 18/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather will still be relatively humid and there will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening slightly early next week, showers will ease off over the region. The weather will improve and it will be hot during the day. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
